company_name: Fujian Highsun Electronic Material Technology Co., Ltd
semiconductor_relevance: High — Fujian Highsun Electronic Material Technology Co., Ltd. specializes in electronic materials, particularly specialty gases and wet chemicals essential for semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: Fujian Highsun Electronic Material Technology Co., Ltd. is a key player in the semiconductor materials sector, focusing on the production of specialty gases, wet chemicals, and rare gases. Established in 2020, the company leverages synergies from the Highsun Group to create a comprehensive electronic materials ecosystem.
capabilities: Wet chemicals for etching and cleaning
Rare gases for various semiconductor applications

regional_presence.China: The company operates dual R&D and manufacturing clusters in Lianjiang (Fujian) and Yumen (Gansu), enhancing its capabilities in the electronic materials sector.
